minor.issue: Backend sets status='disabled' but frontend DiscountsPage STATUS_BADGES map only knows 'active/scheduled/paused/expired' and toggle button is only rendered for status in ['active','paused']. Result: after pause, badge falls back to badge-pending, and toggle button DISAPPEARS so vendor cannot re-activate from UI. Fix either backend (change 'disabled'→'paused') or frontend (accept 'disabled' as paused synonym).

ui_bugs.issue: After pausing a discount, the 'Pause/Activate' toggle button disappears because status becomes 'disabled' (backend) while frontend only shows toggle for status in ['active','paused']. Bell click occasionally does not open the panel (1 of 2 attempts in this run). data-testid 'notifications-panel' timeout after 5s, but on retry it works. rca_of_the_issue: Discount toggle bug RCA: backend server.py toggle_discount() at line 7616 sets new_status = 'disabled' if current is 'active'. However, DiscountsPage.jsx defines STATUS_BADGES with {active, scheduled, paused, expired} and renders toggle button only when discount.status in ['active','paused']. Reproduction: (1) create any percentage discount, (2) click toggle-discount-button-{id}, (3) card badge now shows 'DISABLED' (fallback badge-pending yellow) and the Pause/Activate button is gone — only Delete remains. Mitigation options: (a) backend line 7616 change 'disabled' → 'paused' and line 7623 accordingly, OR (b) frontend: add 'disabled': 'badge-cancelled' in STATUS_BADGES and change condition to ['active','paused','disabled'].includes(discount.status).
